lessons_learned.root_cause: A JWT token used for acceptance testing was stored in a plaintext file (frontend/ba_quiz_token.txt) and accidentally committed along with legitimate changes
preventive_measures: .gitignore now blocks *_token.txt, *.jwt, and similar credential file patterns
QA/acceptance scripts should read tokens exclusively from environment variables, not from committed files (already implemented — TOKEN env var is primary source)
Consider adding a pre-commit hook to scan for credential patterns
